# Standalone build follows qtbase/src/plugins/sqldrivers/CMakeLists.txt.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
if(NOT DEFINED QTBASE_SOURCE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "QTBASE_SOURCE must name verified Qt 6.11.3 sources")
endif()
include("${QTBASE_SOURCE}/.cmake.conf")
set(QT_PARENT_PROJECT_NAME QtBase)
set(QT_STANDALONE_PROJECT_NAME TiledCocoaFix)
set(QT_SKIP_AUTO_PLUGIN_INCLUSION ON)
set(__qt_internal_standalone_project_cmake_build_type_before_project_call "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
project(TiledCocoaFix VERSION 6.11.3 LANGUAGES C CXX)
find_package(Qt6 6.11.3 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS BuildInternals Core Gui)
find_package(Qt6CorePrivate 6.11.3 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Qt6GuiPrivate 6.11.3 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(QT_SBOM_LICENSE_DIRS "${QTBASE_SOURCE}/LICENSES")
qt_build_repo_begin()
add_subdirectory("${QTBASE_SOURCE}/src/plugins/platforms/cocoa" cocoa)
target_sources(QCocoaIntegrationPlugin PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/patchmarker.cpp")
qt_build_repo_end()
